scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const roots=['.turbo','node_modules'];for(const app of fs.existsSync('apps')?fs.readdirSync('apps'):[])for(const d of ['dist','build','coverage','.turbo','node_modules'])roots.push(p.join('apps',app,d));for(const t of roots)fs.rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true});"
